basis_constraints.initialization: deterministic uncentred PCA on qrels-free development candidate residuals
basis_constraints.column_orientation: largest-absolute element in each column is non-negative

int8_quantization.scale: one max-absolute FP32 scale per sidecar dimension divided by 127

pair_mining.promotion: known positive outside Base-PQ Top-10 but within Top-40 versus an unjudged Base-PQ Top-10 challenger, admitted only when same-route FP32 ranks the positive higher
pair_mining.protection: known positive in Base-PQ Top-10 versus an unjudged Base-PQ rank 11-26 challenger, admitted only when same-route FP32 ranks the positive higher
pair_mining.query_balancing: each represented query receives equal total mass within a role; role masses are fixed and renormalized only if a role is absent

basis_optimization.objective: query-balanced smooth-L1 error between predicted and exact pairwise residual margins plus PCA subspace-anchor penalty

comparators.frozen_base: the exact M32 nprobe16 IVF-PQ scores and candidates
comparators.storage_matched_pca: same rank16 int8 payload, alpha 0.75, Top-40 correction, scale rule, candidate pool, and scorer; only the basis objective differs
comparators.same_candidate_exact: FP32 exact scoring of the same frozen candidate pool; non-deployable oracle
comparators.zero_document_byte_query_adapter: closed V7 result, diagnostic only and not rerun
comparators.increased_nprobe: routing-cost baseline reserved for locked evaluation
comparators.m48_rebuild: same 48 representation bytes per document but requires a rebuilt index; limitation baseline reserved for locked evaluation
